subject: general
question: R started walking towards north. During his journey, he turned 7 times right and 5 times left. In which direction he will be facing finally?
solution:
Given:

R starts walking **north**. He takes **7 right turns** and **5 left turns**.

Stepwise Analysis:

Each **right turn** = +90° clockwise

Each **left turn** = -90° (anticlockwise)

Net turns = 7 right - 5 left = 2 right turns

Starting direction: **North**

1st right → **East**

2nd right → **South**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0641a1c5fdefc8e3762bd4b9d96b7308f01b8faf63facf2a8d5391308168c7db.png] 

Hence, R is finally facing **South**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
